summary: Construct immutable one-dimensional cell samples with explicit face grid and boundary data

identity.direction: Explicit cell/face data to spatial operator or state update
identity.definition: Cell centers are arithmetic face midpoints. face_value linearly interpolates inner faces and uses prescribed values or half-cell gradient extrapolation at endpoints. face_grad fits three neighboring point values for internal faces. At the last internal face it uses the two adjacent cells with the actual right Dirichlet value or the prescribed positive-coordinate Neumann derivative. For the latter, let s=(u1-u0)/(x1-x0), b be the boundary, and f the internal face: q_prime(f)=s+(g-s)*(2*f-x0-x1)/(2*b-x0-x1). A boolean N+1 two_point_mask overrides internal gradients with adjacent secants. Endpoint Dirichlet gradients remain half-cell secants; Neumann gradients are prescribed. grad is the face_value difference divided by cell width.
identity.geometry: Explicit one-dimensional face grid, cell centers at arithmetic midpoints
identity.coordinates: Caller coordinate X; positive increasing direction
identity.boundary: One scalar Dirichlet value or positive-coordinate Neumann gradient at each end; homogeneous unit cross-section unless metrics supplied
assumptions: Finite converted-binary64 input quantities; caller supplies consistent units and normalization

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Point samples at arithmetic cell centers, not cell volume averages

inputs.name: face_centers
inputs.description: Explicit monotonically increasing cell boundary coordinates
inputs.constraints: Finite strictly increasing; finite positive widths and distinct midpoint spacings

inputs.name: left_face_constraint
inputs.constraints: Exactly one of value or gradient is non-None at each end; finite scalar when set

inputs.name: right_face_constraint
inputs.constraints: Exactly one of value or gradient is non-None at each end; finite scalar when set

inputs.name: left_face_grad_constraint
inputs.description: Boundary du/dx in positive coordinate direction at this end
inputs.constraints: Exactly one of value or gradient is non-None at each end; finite scalar when set

inputs.name: right_face_grad_constraint
inputs.description: Boundary du/dx in positive coordinate direction at this end
inputs.constraints: Exactly one of value or gradient is non-None at each end; finite scalar when set

outputs.name: variable
outputs.description: Immutable copied float64 CellVariable with face_value(), face_grad() and grad()
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

preconditions: Declared shapes, domains and matching scientific conventions; no implicit broadcasting
supported: Construct immutable one-dimensional cell samples with explicit face grid and boundary data
excluded: Unbatched point values only, N>=2. No alternate-coordinate chain-rule x port, mesh adaptation, area/volume inference or JAX transformations.
Quadratic internal-face exactness does not establish global second order with arbitrary boundary data or arbitrary distorted grids.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for shape/domain/finite/masked input failures; FVM nonnumeric inputs raise TypeError. No partial result.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iteration; theta is one linear solve. No convergence flag is fabricated.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial output returned on failure.

python.signature: CellVariable(value: object, face_centers: object, left_face_constraint: object = None, right_face_constraint: object = None, left_face_grad_constraint: object = 0.0, right_face_grad_constraint: object = 0.0) -> None

example.description: Construct a two-cell variable with unit Neumann gradients and verify face reconstruction.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.fvm import CellVariable
v=CellVariable([.5,1.5],[0.,1.,2.],left_face_grad_constraint=1.,right_face_grad_constraint=1.)
np.testing.assert_allclose(v.face_value(),[0.,1.,2.])
np.testing.assert_allclose(v.face_grad(),1.)
example.expected: The face values are [0, 1, 2] and the reconstructed face gradient is one everywhere.

scope: Independent flux conservation, exact linear/constant states, uniform manufactured diffusion convergence and theta causality checks

Quadratic, linear and constant face derivatives with matching Neumann data on unequal terminal widths and N=2; the derivative-constrained reconstruction replaces the inaccurate linearly extrapolated boundary value. Explicit two-point masks, Dirichlet endpoint half-cell secants and linear face values retain their definitions.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Named discrete invariants and manufactured uniform-grid convergence; no arbitrary-grid stability/accuracy or full transport-simulation claim.
known_limitations: Unbatched point values only, N>=2. No alternate-coordinate chain-rule x port, mesh adaptation, area/volume inference or JAX transformations.
Quadratic internal-face exactness does not establish global second order with arbitrary boundary data or arbitrary distorted grids.
